article.headline: What is a Telegram Mini App and how to build it without coding
article.lead: A Telegram Mini App is a web-service format inside the messenger that gives businesses fast, convenient access to their audience. Let's explore how these solutions work, where they are used and how to launch your own project without code together with the Unitee Space platform.

figureIntro.alt: Telegram Mini App – the new era of web technology
figureIntro.caption: Telegram Mini App – the new era of web technology

intro: Mini Apps in Telegram are compact yet capable web services that run right inside the messenger. They let users interact with services without switching to websites or separate apps. Order food, book a ticket, take a survey or play a game – all inside one window.

The key difference from traditional mobile solutions is that they do not take space on the device and require no installation. A user simply opens a Telegram Mini App, authorises in a couple of clicks and gets access to every feature. For businesses that means a quick launch, no complex store publication and easy support.

You can build a Mini App today even without a development team: just use an intuitive builder with ready integrations and blocks. This is exactly what Unitee Space provides, giving businesses and communities visual tools to design Telegram experiences.

sectionHowWorks.title: How do Mini Apps work in Telegram?
sectionHowWorks.paragraph: Mini Apps launch in Web App mode and rely on standard web technologies – HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Every interaction goes through the Telegram API, so the service displays correctly on mobile and desktop while authorisation, payments and notifications stay inside the ecosystem.

constructor.title: Mini App builders
constructor.paragraph: Modern platforms offer ready templates and visual editors, so you just choose a structure, upload content and connect a bot. Such a builder saves time and lets you focus on user experience.

adminFigure.alt: Telegram Mini Apps admin panel powered by Unitee
adminFigure.caption: Admin panel for Telegram Mini Apps powered by Unitee

api.title: Working with the Telegram API
api.paragraph: Through the Telegram API a Telegram Mini App receives user data (with permission), connects payments and integrates with external services. This enables personalised flows and automates communication.

security.title: Convenience and security
security.paragraph: A Telegram Mini App runs within Telegram's secure infrastructure: data never leaves the messenger and sign-in happens through a verified account. Users trust the familiar environment, while businesses rely on ready-made authorisation and notification tools.

sectionHowTo.title: How to build a Mini App without programming?
sectionHowTo.intro: Follow a clear plan: choose a platform, assemble the interface, connect the bot and test your flows. Let's review the key stages using Unitee Space and other popular solutions as examples.

step1.title: Step 1. Choose a platform
step1.paragraph: Solutions such as Tars, ManyChat, Chatfuel and Landbot provide visual editors with ready blocks. Teams that want full control should look at Unitee Space: the platform combines a powerful builder, built-in analytics and flexible no-code logic.

figure1.alt: Share Mini Apps in Telegram and the TON coin
figure1.caption: Share Mini Apps in Telegram and the TON coin

step2.title: Step 2. Configure the interface
step2.paragraph: Visual elements – buttons, forms, product cards – are adjusted with drag-and-drop. Plan the actions a user should take: sign up, submit a request, pay for an order. In the builder by Unitee Space every block adapts to mobile screens and matches your brand.

step3.title: Step 3. Integrate with the Telegram API
step3.paragraph: Connect the bot via BotFather and link your flows to the required webhooks. In a Telegram Mini App you can add payments, notifications and personalised recommendations. Unitee Space issues secure tokens automatically and guides your integration tests.

figure2.alt: Telegram Mini App – a web application
figure2.caption: Telegram Mini App is a web application

step4.title: Step 4. Testing and launch
step4.paragraph: Check how the service behaves on different devices and network speeds. A polished Telegram Mini App should load fast, render forms correctly and send notifications instantly. Unitee Space offers staging environments and launch checklists.

step5.title: Step 5. Acquire users
step5.paragraph: After launch run promo campaigns, add the Mini App catalogue and pin a shortcut to the smartphone home screen. Use built-in analytics and monetisation tools to measure conversion and expand the product.

sectionConclusion.title: Takeaways
paragraphs: Telegram Mini App is an efficient way to launch a digital service without building native applications. Updates deploy instantly, you can pin a shortcut to the smartphone home screen and all customer data stays protected.

With the Unitee Space platform companies get a complete toolkit: visual builder, built-in analytics, flexible monetisation tools and integrations with CRM. This speeds up launches, keeps performance under control and scales the Telegram ecosystem.
